title: Former soldier sees triangle take off at Area 51

tellings.quote: weirdly enough, I've talked to a guy who former uh army in the the mid 2010s who said he saw a a like a triangle craft jut off of an airway in Area 51.

plain: A former Army man is said to have watched a triangle-shaped craft shoot off a runway at Area 51, the secret military test base in Nevada, in the mid-2010s. The online researcher UAPGerb tells Michels that he spoke with this man himself and does not name him. If it is true, a triangle craft was flying out of the base only a few years ago.
